title: Create Catalog/Schema/Table
description: Request creation of a new catalog, schema, or table

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Catalog/schema/table creation requests are typically processed within 3-5 business days. New catalog creation requires additional governance review and may take up to 7 business days. Production catalogs require data owner approval.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Naming conventions matter - Use lowercase with underscores (e.g., "sales_data", not "SalesData")
  • Check if a catalog/schema already exists before requesting - duplicates cause confusion
  • Catalogs are organization-wide - make sure the name is appropriate for all teams
  • Schemas are typically created within existing catalogs - specify which catalog if you're only creating a schema
  • Table creation is usually done via SQL after schema access - only request table creation if you need special permissions
  • Be clear about the purpose - this helps with governance and future maintenance
  • Production catalogs require data retention and backup policies - include these in your justification
